dataset: BUSI (Breast Ultrasound Images Dataset) via HuggingFace theshoaibme/panorgan-busi-breast-ultrasound
split: stratified 70/15/15 (train 550 / val 115 / test 115); final model trained on train+val (665) + 551 mask-cropped samples
training: round 3 of 5: 8 head epochs (frozen backbone, LR 1e-3) + 12 fine-tune epochs (LR 1e-4, cosine), batch 8, augmentation: flips/rotation/affine/color jitter + mask-crop
target_85pct: NOT reached (78.26% with 4-way TTA; 76.52% with hflip TTA; 73.91% single-pass)
notes: Load with the exact classifier head above. For best accuracy at inference, use 4-way TTA (see eval_method in us_metrics.json). Malignant recall is the weakest class (see per-class metrics).
